test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is "Cowardise." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Cowardise"** is misspelt. • The correctly spelt word is **"Cowardice."** • It means** **a lack of courage; behaviour that shows that you are afraid. (साहस का कमी; भीरुता, कायरता) • **Example**: ***Cowardice**__ prevented me from doing what I knew I should do.* • Hence, the answer is option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Adequate: **enough for what you need. (आवश्‍यकता के अनुसार पर्याप्त) • **Precaution: **something that you do now in order to avoid danger or problems in the future. (भविष्‍य के ख़तरे या समस्‍या से बचने के लिए किया गया उपाय; एहतियात, सावधानी) • **Ridiculous: **very silly or unreasonable. (मूखर्तापूर्ण या बेतुका) 1a1:Tc45, The correct answer is **"Opaque."**
